notes: Craft: the scene deliberately stalls at the apparatus (scene m-ares-3-apparatus): exposure without payment, display without release — the record's own limit is staged rather than narratively resolved. Forge scenes use the family-hellenic forge palette; the surety scene uses the sea palette. Word-formations ("Ares", "Aphrodite") render as particle glyphs at draft count and remain legible at authored count. Editor defects listed below are shared, returned for one repair. E0 acceptance repair: title/field collision fixed on m-ares-0-song, m-ares-0b-bonds, m-ares-1-genealogies, m-ares-2-difference, m-ares-3-apparatus, m-ares-4-surety, m-ares-5-return (title width 560; formations iteratively scaled and dropped clear of the title band); cover re-captured.

#0 song — attraction authored as field: Ares and Aphrodite carry attract forces (the secret gathering), Helios a weak repel at the rim (the seeing that withdraws nothing); slow circulation 0.35; the song takes time (duration 14, the longest opening beat).

#0b bonds — the bond carrier walks the bed: · at the left post → ✕ at the right → ✕✕✕ suspended above, tint brightening as the work completes; field holds inward (circulation −0.45, speed 0.3, dispersion 0.03); pointer repel/pulse faint — nothing may reach the bed. The same ring that gathered in #0 now encloses.

#1 genealogies — grid layout: witnesses in columns that hold their seams; Eros walks his two tellings (Eros at the primordial disc → Ἔρως at the filial station), the recurrence-with-difference staging the record's own claim that Eros has more than one genealogy and neither is collapsed; pointer shove — tellings refuse merging.

#2 difference — the union ring morphs ring → triangle (the backwards-turning fastening, the drawn bow) → yantra (Harmonia's sustained form); a sine LFO breathes field circulation (the lyre's held note, the 9/8 tick); Ares and Aphrodite pull toward the form without moving from ±0.5 — distinct poles, generative between; pointer vortex (countertension).

#3 apparatus — THE 3D SCENE. z is the vertical of the apparatus: the net ring at z 0 closes over the lovers (z −0.05/−0.08), the exhibit platform below (z −0.42), the anvil at depth (z −0.3), the laughing gods above (z +0.35), Helios highest (z +0.5) — who stands above the display is the record's own question (the goddesses stay home; shame unevenly distributed); depth occlusion + dark-bronze depth tint; the net sequence tightens then holds (the stall); field nearly still (speed 0.25, circulation 0.05) — the scene stalls where the apparatus stalls; pointer vortex with shove click (the seizure).

#4 surety — the pledge triangle grows from pale refused promise to gold undertaking; Hephaestus becomes ⚒ and moves to the bonds (the same hands loosening); the bond ring widens and fades (loosened); Ares still pale (release not yet narrated as departure here); pointer attract/implode — the word gathers the debt to a named bearer; triangle LFO breathes pointer strength (the oath's weight).

#5→0 return — the two path-discs carry attract fields at opposite edges (Thrace, Paphos — lives in motion beyond the image); the net ring recedes (widens, tint 0.3→0.12 — the apparatus becoming background); near-still pointer (0.10) — no capture left; the unnarrated '?' stays bright at the rim. ENDING QUALIFIES BEGINNING: the field that opened with two attract forces gathering toward a bed inside a house now holds two attract forces drawing toward open paths at the frame's edge — same forces, transformed office: attraction without enclosure; the sun that saw and reported in #0 has set (no ☉ here), and what remains of exposure is the '?' — the debt the song did not narrate. The dark field (whiteOnBlack, kept from the forge scenes) says the song-world's daylight does not return: the relation continues past its telling.

Human-amplified staging: #2's hamartia re-entry and #5→0's Graces note carry whose account it is in the scene bodies (Taylor's quilt operation; source event with no appointed amplification). Mythemic verbs only: the bonds demonstrate enclosure, the undertaking proves-discloses trust — no formal entailment, no attribution of QL operations to Homer or Hesiod.

Automation: auto-lyre (field.params.circulation sine, the lyre's held tension) and auto-oath (field.params.pointerStrength triangle, the oath's weight) — both tied to the record's moves. Durations 10–16 and transitions 1.0–2.4: the stall (#3, 16s) and the return (15s) are held longer than the forging (10s).

glyph_rationales.♪: Demodocus' song itself: the whole scene exists as what the lyre carries to the Phaeacians (#0).
glyph_rationales.☀: Helios: the seeing that reports — knowledge of the hidden entering another's hands, twice (#0b).
glyph_rationales.†: Deimos and Phobos: terror and fear born beside Harmonia — the stakes kept within the same family (#1).
glyph_rationales.9/8: the retained ratio: read as a defect to erase it would destroy the completion it enables — the octave kept whole by its remainder (#2).
glyph_rationales.3×: Hermes' answer: three times the bonds, all the gods looking on — the deterrent received as inducement (#3).
glyph_rationales.⚖: the guarantee: a named bearer of possible loss standing behind the disputed continuation (#4).
glyph_rationales.6: the count of two poles and their four ordered pairings: beside, never instead of, the eight determinations (#5→0).
glyph_rationales.Demodocus' lyre — the song that carries: the kithara drawn: the bard among the Phaeacians — the tale's body is the song itself (#0).
glyph_rationales.the hidden bed — the affair in the craft: the bed drawn: Ares and Aphrodite in Hephaestus' house, the secret the song opens (#0).
glyph_rationales.the gods at the door — the audience alre: the wide ring: the spectators around the tale before the trap is sprung (#0).
glyph_rationales.the song itself: the note beside the lyre: what binds hearing to the whole (#0).
glyph_rationales.the bonds — unbreakable, finely wrought,: the drawn net: δεσμοὶ τεχνήεντες — craft making an arrangement no one can break or loosen (#0b).
glyph_rationales.the feigned departure — Lemnos, the sign: the island drawn: what Ares reads as the husband's absence has been prepared for him (#0b).
glyph_rationales.the chamber prepared — knowledge turned: the square: Helios' report, Hephaestus' making and Ares' reading entering one effective sequence (#0b).
glyph_rationales.Helios — the seeing that reports: the sun: sees, reports, watches again and reports the capture (#0b).
glyph_rationales.Aphrodite from the sea — her entrance am: the figure over the scallop and waves: emergence after the severing — a different occasion from the song's address to Zeus (#1).
glyph_rationales.Harmonia's line — the genealogy into a h: the branching tree drawn through three generations: the divine parentage continuing into Cadmus' household (#1).
glyph_rationales.Eros' two tellings — primordial power an: one ring, two tints in sequence: the primordial Eros beside Chaos, and the separately reported child of Ares and Aphrodite (#1).
glyph_rationales.Deimos and Phobos — terror and fear besi: the dagger: the terrors of battle the same parentage bears — differentiation can become hostility (#1).
glyph_rationales.the same shape — bow and lyre, the tensi: one drawn form turning bow, then lyre: what differs agrees through a backwards-turning fastening (#2).
glyph_rationales.the two powers — distinct being and join: spear and blossom side by side: Ares' refusal and Aphrodite's attraction, each keeping its office (#2).
glyph_rationales.severance — the cut that denies relation: the triangle's hard edges: difference converted into enemy (#2).
glyph_rationales.fusion — the join that absorbs the diffe: the filled disc: relation converted into a demand to surrender the difference one wished to meet (#2).
glyph_rationales.the retained tone: the ratio on the stage's edge: the incomputable seam kept — the bow remembering it is also a lyre (#2).
glyph_rationales.the public exhibit — the held bodies on: the drawn display: surveillance, fabrication and immobilisation ending in a public exhibit (#3).
glyph_rationales.the spectators — laughter at the display: three drawn figures: the gods' laughter, no single moral verdict (#3).
glyph_rationales.Hermes' answer — three times the bonds a: the count on the stage's edge: multiplied bonds and a larger audience as the acceptable price of desire (#3).
glyph_rationales.the stall — reciprocity arrested: the cold square: counterfeit gathering — the relation held visibly together and prevented from answering (#3).
glyph_rationales.Poseidon — the sea taking the debt on it: the trident: if Ares flees without paying, Poseidon will pay (#4).
glyph_rationales.the loosening — the same hands undoing t: the opened chain: technē retaining the capacity to make and to release (#4).
glyph_rationales.the undertaking — the sea's own word beh: the wide ring: Hephaestus' objection answered without making Ares' future conduct present to inspection (#4).
glyph_rationales.the guarantee: the scales on the stage's edge: the shifted bearer of a possible loss (#4).
glyph_rationales.the paths apart — Thrace and Paphos: two roads from one stem: the spectators' scene no longer containing them (#5→0).
glyph_rationales.the Graces — bathing, anointing, clothin: three drawn figures with their vessels: Aphrodite's reception at Paphos — the event Homer keeps (#5→0).
glyph_rationales.the continuing field — the claim persist: the wide ring holding paths and Graces: what the bonds achieved, what the undertaking enabled, and what the field still bears (#5→0).
glyph_rationales.the count of two poles and their four pa: the numeral on the stage's edge: the local arithmetic kept in its place under the native determinations (#5→0).
